item.description:
- Connected the live US$5 Clipboard Board product and its one-Mac license checkout. - Added license activation, periodic validation and seven-day offline access. Settings and history export remain available if activation is missing or rejected. - Added background update checks on internet reconnect, limited to once per fifteen minutes.
- Added envelope icons and Email labels for standalone addresses in History and Quick Pick. - Added swatches for #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB and #RRGGBBAA values, with checkerboard transparency and visible borders in light/dark themes. - Recognition is local presentation metadata. Original whitespace, case, copied content, storage types and privacy filtering remain unchanged. - Invalid colors, surrounding prose and ambiguous email values retain their ordinary preview.
- Grouped History and its filtered results under Today, Yesterday and Earlier, with counts and newest activity first. - Kept Pinned and Shelf as separate lists; keyboard navigation and number shortcuts follow selectable rows, not headings. - Refresh day headings on local midnight, clock/time-zone changes, wake and reopening without adding a polling timer. - Recover keyboard selection when an entry is removed or expires.
- Added a temporary local queue in Quick Pick with per-row Add buttons, repeated entries, progress, and reordering of pending entries. - Added Paste Next, Previous, Skip, Retry Last and Clear controls, plus a menu-bar action and optional global Paste Next shortcut in Settings → Advanced. - Preserve queue progress on missing history/files, denied Accessibility access or destination focus failure. Progress means a paste command was sent, not verified receipt by the destination app. - Queue stores only item references in memory and clears on quit; it is neither synced nor backed up. - Corrected global hotkey dispatch to match each registered shortcut identifier.
- Reused Quick Actions as Quick Pick, available from the clipboard panel and menu bar as well as its existing configurable shortcut. - Added visible Command-1–9 badges and selection shortcuts that remain available while searching. - Kept number assignments stable during each open session, including gaps for deleted entries; new captures appear on reopening. - Quick Pick copies by default, follows the existing paste-on-selection preference, and offers an explicit Paste button. - Kept temporary Shelf references separate from recent clipboard picks.
